The graduation
thesis
 is
 provided
opportunities for students to consolidate, review and synthesize the knowledge
they have learned during their time at school.

-

Prospective
students
 have
 the
opportunity to apply their knowledge in the real world of production and
business. 

-

Students can
participate in the analysis, research and problem-solving related to the
discipline.

-

Prospective
students
 have
 the
opportunity to compare and apply the knowledge and skills learned in practice. 

-

By doing the thesis,
 students 
can 
develop their ability to think creatively
in order to adapt to the continuous change of society and the ability to research
in order to actively seek new ideas and lifelong learning.

clos.loDetails: Help students gain access to and apply the fundamentals of international business in solving business problems
Facilitate students to analyze and evaluate the actual international business strategies of the business.
Facilitate students to analyze the environment and operations of the business through the application of modern software and analytical tools.
Create opportunities for students to research, think and explore, explore new knowledge in the field of International business.
Facilitate students to plan and organize international business activities through assessment and research.
Educate students about the attitudes, spirit and ability to learn throughout life
